## EA Media Tools 2.0.0 — jaguar

### Encoder controls

- Configure P1–P7 speed using the native preset supported by NVENC, QSV, AMF, VideoToolbox, x264, x265, or SVT-AV1.
- Choose only tune modes supported by the active encoder.
- Customize B-frames, multipass, B-frame references, adaptive B-frames, scene-cut detection, RC lookahead, non-reference P-frames, spatial AQ, and temporal AQ when the encoder supports them.
- See the selected hardware or software decoder directly in the workspace footer.

### Editable presets

- Built-in values now load from the installed `presets.ini`.
- Named custom presets are stored in one per-user `custom_preset.ini`, created only after the first custom preset is saved.
- Configuration booleans use `0` and `1`, and configuration guidance now lives in the README instead of comments inside the files.
- Control changes update the FFmpeg command immediately without losing the current scroll position.

### Output and packaging

- Streaming video audio now uses Opus at 96 kbit/s for stereo or 128 kbit/s when downmixing surround audio.
- Auto-crop uses native CUVID and QSV paths where available and preserves cropped aspect ratios on AMF, VA-API, VideoToolbox, and CPU paths.
- Windows installers include the release version in their filenames, such as `EA-Media-Tools-2.0.0-x64-Setup.exe`.

### Validation

- Lint, native and compatibility TypeScript checks, unit tests, and production packaging.

[Review all changes since v1.2.1](https://github.com/eaforlife/media-converter/compare/v1.2.1...v2.0.0).
